```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"max_depth\":1,\"max_pages\":3,\"user_agents\":[\"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) TestAgent-1\",\"Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15) TestAgent-2\"]}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.crawl(engine: engineObj, url: url)
```
